name: same-fix-already-on-another-branch
hook: When a bug matches a prior-art branch diff, check if it's merged to base
body: The exact same bug (#2038) was already fixed on branch 2038-p1-frontend-routes-ask-practice-stats-test-study-a (commit b6ec366ed) with the same fix. When encountering a bug, check if prior-art branches already contain the fix and whether those branches are ancestors of the current HEAD.
why: This bug was already fixed elsewhere but not merged. Checking prior-art diffs would have immediately revealed the fix pattern.

name: redirect-to-onboarding-not-root
hook: Missing gradeLevel should redirect to /onboarding/persona, not /
body: Routes gated on gradeLevel (RequireCourseSelection, StudyContent) must redirect to /onboarding/persona when gradeLevel is missing, NOT to /. The homepage (/) falls back to /start when no home page exists in the CMS, creating a silent redirect chain that confuses QA.
why: The redirect chain / -> /start hides the fact that onboarding is required, making the bug invisible until manual QA.
